verdict.rationale: Mailchimp Transactional (formerly Mandrill) is a separate API/SMTP sending product. It has its own rejection allowlist/denylist and can provision dedicated IPs, which supports separate suppression rules and sending reputation. However, one community report says a single complaint about a marketing email led Mailchimp to shut off Mandrill processing, suggesting the account-level separation is incomplete. Missing for 10: any evidence of transactional-specific templates, explicit documentation that transactional mail bypasses marketing unsubscribes (e.g. a receipt reaching an unsubscribed contact), clear statement of reputation isolation from marketing, independent hands-on corroboration.
